title: The Letter in the Rain
style_prompt: monochrome manga, screentone shading, dynamic ink linework

panels.scene_description: Aiko stands alone on a rain-soaked train platform, clutching a folded letter.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three years since she'd last read it.

panels.scene_description: Close on Aiko's hands trembling as she unfolds the damp paper.
Aiko looks up sharply, eyes wide, as a train horn sounds in the distance.
A young man, Ren, steps off the arriving train, scanning the platform crowd.
Aiko freezes, letter still in hand, rain dripping from her hair.
Wide shot of Ren and Aiko facing each other across the platform, the whole station bustling around them.
